newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM launches Stockholm freighter on Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: KLM launches Stockholm freighter on Oct 1.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV KLM AS said in a statement it will operate a full freighter between Amsterdam Schiphol and Stockholm five times weekly on Monday to Friday from October 1.
An airline spokesman said the aircraft -- a Shorts Belfast leased from UK-based HeavyLift Cargo Airlines -- will leave at Schiphol at 1830 local and arrive in Stockholm at 2100.

KLM added the addition of Stockholm to scheduled services with maindeck capacity, will substantially shorten throughput time for air cargo to and from Scandinavia. Shippers in the region will be able to connect to the entire KLM network within 24 hours.
It added that it expects the new service to help Finnish as well as Swedish exporters, and also shippers seeking to import goods into Baltic states, and to St Petersburg.
To free up aircraft capacity, KLM Cargo's freighter service to and from its sub-hub of Malmo in Sweden has been rescheduled, it said.

It has also ensured that air cargo from this network can also connect within 24 hours to its network. The Malmo service departs every day except Monday, it added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
